appliesWhen.semanticAnchor: building ParameterCollection parameters, reading output parameters, writing QueryResultModelHandler or QueryResultHandler delegates, concurrent fan-out queries across shards, and per-shard ShardsValues parameter overrides

fields.body: Build `ParameterCollection` instances on the caller thread before invoking any data method. Never read output parameter values from the original input `DbParameter` objects after execution—each connection or shard clones the parameters onto its own `DbCommand`, so output values must be read from the `DbParameterCollection` passed into the result handler or via `Mapper.MapOutput`. Keep `QueryResultModelHandler` and `QueryResultHandler` delegates stateless and thread-safe: never mutate shared caller state or the input `ParameterCollection` inside a handler, because handlers execute concurrently across shards and may be re-invoked across Polly retries. Use `ShardsValues` when a fan-out query requires per-shard parameter overrides or shard filtering.
fields.title: Parameter collection cloning and result handler thread safety
